stem: Which Indian film actor has been included in the Time Magazine's list of hundred most influential people of 2020?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above /More than one of the above

expl: On 22 September 2020, the famous Bollywood actor Ayushmann Khurrana was included in Time Magazine’s list of the 100 most influential people for the year 2020. Time Magazine did not include any Indian citizen in the list of the 100 most influential people in the world in the year 2025.

stem: Who issued the death fatwa against Salman Rushdie?
expl: Salman Rushdie, an Indian-born novelist, became famous through his second novel Midnight’s Children (1981), which received the Booker Prize. In 1988, his novel The Satanic Verses faced strong protest and criticism in Muslim countries, and in 1989, Iran’s then religious leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini issued a death fatwa against him because of this book.

stem: The highest railway bridge in the world is built over which of the following rivers?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: In India, the world’s highest railway bridge has been built over the Chenab River. This bridge has been constructed over the Chenab River in the Reasi district of Jammu and Kashmir. Its height is 359 metres, which makes it higher than the Eiffel Tower in Paris.

stem: In which of the following cities/towns did the India Foundation, in collaboration with Nalanda University,organize the 5th World Dharma-Dhamma Conference on July 27-28, 2019?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: During 27–28 July 2019, India Foundation, in collaboration with Nalanda University, organized the Fifth International Dharma–Dhamma Conference at the Rajgir International Convention Centre in Rajgir (Bihar). The theme of this conference was ‘Sat-Chit-Ananda and Nirvana’. During 18–20 September 2025, the 9th International Dharma– Dhamma Conference was held at Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University, Ahmedabad (Gujarat).

stem: Which State of India has decided to build 'Mother India Temple'?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: In 2018, the Madhya Pradesh Government decided to construct a ‘Bharat Mata Temple’ in Bhopal. A Bharat Mata Temple is also located in Haridwar (Uttarakhand), which was established by Swami Satyamitranand Giri.

stem: India's first National Rail and Transportation University is established at–

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: India’s first National Rail and Transportation Institute (present name—Gati Shakti University) was established in Vadodara, Gujarat. It was launched on 5 September 2018, on Teachers’ Day. This university was established as a deemed-to-be university under the University Grants Commission (Institutions Deemed to be Universities) Regulations, 2016, under the de novo category.

stem: Which is the first state in India to use robotic technology to clean all its active manholes?
expl: Kerala has become the country’s first state to make the cleaning of operational manholes completely robotic. It may be noted that in February 2023, the Water Resources Minister of Kerala launched a robotic scavenger named Bandicoot

stem: Which of the following is NOT a special category state as of 2023?
expl: The concept of Special Category States emerged in 1969 when the Government of India accepted that some states face greater developmental challenges than others. The criteria for Special Category States include hilly terrain, low population density, a large tribal population, a strategic border location, economic and infrastructural backwardness, and the non-viable nature of the state’s finances. Earlier, it included 11 states adb UTs—Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Sikkim, Tripura, Himachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Jammu and Kashmir, and Uttarakhand. At the time of the formation of Telangana, considering its economic and social situation, it was granted Special Category status; however, at present, Telangana does not have Special Category status. The Special Category status that Telangana received at the time of its formation became effectively non-operational after 2015 due to changes in the financial system. Now, Telangana receives the same tax share and general central plan assistance from the Centre as other general category states.

stem: When was INS Imphal inducted into the Indian Navy?
expl: Sea trials of INS Imphal began in April 2023, and in October 2023 it was handed over to the Indian Navy. It was commissioned on 26 December 2023.

stem: The first city in India to get the status of Green Railway Station in 2023 is -
expl: In January 2023, Visakhapatnam Railway Station, under the East Coast Railway, was awarded the ‘Green Railway Station’ certification with the highest rating of Platinum by the Indian Green Building Council for adopting the green concept.

stem: In which Indian city has the regional office of Universal Postal Union been established?
expl: In July 2023, the Regional Office of the Universal Postal Union was inaugurated in New Delhi by the Minister of State for Communications, Devusinh Chauhan, and the Director General of the Universal Postal Union, Masahiko Metoki.

stem: Who has been appointed as the Regional Director of the WHO's South-East Asia Region on November 1, 2023?
expl: In 2023, Bangladesh’s Saima Wazed was nominated as the next Regional Director of the WHO South-East Asia Region. She assumed office as the Regional Director of the World Health Organization’s South-East Asia Region on 1 February 2024. However, her appointment was confirmed on 23 January 2024 by the WHO Executive Board in Geneva, Switzerland.

stem: Which of the following statements is not true regarding the President of Egypt, Al-Sisi?

options.label: a
options.text: He was the chief guest at the Republic Day on January 26, 2023.

options.label: b
options.text: He has been elected President of Egypt for the second consecutive time.

options.label: d
options.text: Their current term will be 6 years.

expl: Egypt’s President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi was the chief guest at the Republic Day ceremony on 26 January 2023. In December 2023, Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi was elected President of Egypt for the third time. His term as President is 6 years. In the 2023 presidential election, he received 89.6% of the votes.

stem: The venue for the world's first Artificial Intelligence Safety Conference, held on November 1-2, 2023, is:'
expl: The world’s first Artificial Intelligence Safety Summit was held on 1–2 November 2023 at Bletchley Park, Buckingham (England). This summit is an important step from a global perspective to deal with the challenges created by AI technologies.

stem: The certified seed production program, which started in 2022-23, provides an incentive of to farmers.
expl: In the Certified Seed Production Programme started in 2022–23, it was announced that farmers would be given an incentive of Rs. 1,000 per quintal for certified seed production and, for distribution, Rs. 1,200 per quintal or 50% of the cost (whichever is lower). In the answer key issued by the Commission, option (c) has been considered correct.

stem: The largest liquid mirror telescope in Asia has been installed.
expl: Asia’s largest Liquid Mirror Telescope has been established at the Devasthal Observatory campus of the Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences, Nainital (Uttarakhand).

stem: What countries are related to 'Operation Dost', which was completed on February 29, 2023?
expl: ‘Operation Dost’ was a search and rescue operation run by the Government of India for relief and assistance after the earthquake in Türkiye–Syria in February 2023.
